hints: The required volume of revolution is the volume of the outer cylinder minus the volume under the curve between $x = 1$ and $x = 2.4$.
Calculate the cylinder volume $V_{\text{cylinder}} = \pi r^2 h = \pi (1)^2 (2.4 - 1) = 1.4\pi = \frac{7}{5}\pi$.
Integrate $\pi y^2 = \pi (5x-4)^{-2/3}$ with respect to $x$ using the reverse chain rule.
Evaluate the integral between $1$ and $2.4$ and subtract from the cylinder volume.
walkthrough:
Calculate the volume of the solid cylinder formed by rotating the line $y = 1$ between $x = 1$ and $x = 2.4$:
$$V_{\text{cylinder}} = \pi \int_1^{2.4} 1^2\,dx = \pi (2.4 - 1) = 1.4\pi = \frac{7}{5}\pi$$

Set up the integral for the volume under the curve $y = (5x-4)^{-1/3}$ rotated about the $x$-axis:
$$V_{\text{curve}} = \pi \int_1^{2.4} y^2\,dx = \pi \int_1^{2.4} (5x-4)^{-2/3}\,dx$$

Integrate using the reverse chain rule:
$$\int (5x-4)^{-2/3}\,dx = \frac{(5x-4)^{1/3}}{\frac{1}{3} \cdot 5} = \frac{3}{5}(5x-4)^{1/3}$$

Evaluate the definite integral between the limits $x = 1$ and $x = 2.4$:
$$V_{\text{curve}} = \pi \left[ \frac{3}{5}(5x-4)^{1/3} \right]_1^{2.4} = \frac{3}{5}\pi \left( (5(2.4)-4)^{1/3} - (5(1)-4)^{1/3} \right) = \frac{3}{5}\pi \left( 8^{1/3} - 1^{1/3} \right) = \frac{3}{5}\pi(2 - 1) = \frac{3}{5}\pi$$

Subtract the volume under the curve from the cylinder volume to find the shaded solid volume:
$$V = V_{\text{cylinder}} - V_{\text{curve}} = \frac{7}{5}\pi - \frac{3}{5}\pi = \frac{4}{5}\pi$$
